name: Rokytnice nad Rokytnou (Czechia)
description: Divided by a white wavy diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a red lower hoist part bearing a yellow crozier with white sudarium and a blue upper fly part bearing a yellow oval sieve.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 December 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
